metadata.title: Prisma · Psychological assessment for HR teams
metadata.description: Run validated psychological tests and questionnaires, score them automatically and review results for your team.

hero.title: Psychological assessment for HR teams
hero.subtitle: Run established tests and questionnaires online, get results scored automatically, and keep every employee's profile in one place.

library.title: Ready-made library
library.text: Twenty validated instruments and questionnaires are included, from anxiety and depression screening to leadership and cognitive tests.

scoring.title: Automatic scoring
scoring.text: Raw scores, T-scores and stens are calculated the moment a test is submitted, with interpretation text for each scale.

reports.title: Per-person reports
reports.text: See every result for an employee side by side, add your conclusion and print or archive it.

groups.title: Groups and follow-up
groups.text: Flag people who need attention and track groups across departments.

import.title: Import or pick instruments
import.text: Use the built-in library or upload your own tests and questionnaires from an Excel template.

invite.title: Employees take them online
invite.text: People sign up and complete assessments from any browser, at their own pace.

review.title: Review results
review.text: Scores and interpretations are ready immediately in the admin dashboard.

footer.disclaimer: Results support, and never replace, a qualified psychologist's judgement.
